_comment: Read by agent-loops/worktree-janitor/janitor.py (MacBook Pro, daily 08:30). Three rules: (1) a worktree whose branch content is already in any target branch is removed, with its servers reaped and any uncommitted work archived first; (2) dev servers (api / worker / web, node family only) running from a worktree for longer than servers.maxAgeHours are killed - pnpm dev brings them back; (3) worktrees idle for idleAlert.idleDays that are NOT merged are emailed as a digest for a human decision. Infra (postgres, redis, temporal, docker, playwright, editors) is never touched.

servers._classes: api = apps/api or src/server.ts; worker = apps/worker; web = vite / wrangler / workerd / next; helper = esbuild service / tsx watch spawned by those. Only node-family processes whose cwd is inside a worktree are ever candidates.

removal._comment: A merged worktree is kept while it has uncommitted changes touched within dirtyGraceDays, or was created less than minAgeHours ago: a fresh worktree with only uncommitted work is 'merged' by ancestry and must not be swept mid-task. Worktrees checked out on a target branch (main/staging) are never removed.
